notes: Modified cash basis county, governmental funds only. Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6). Fund balances (p6) recorded as fund balance; ending cash = Cash and cash equivalents 8,841,099 and certificates of deposit 1,360,000 as ending investments (p4); beginning cash not printed (null). Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement Total column (p4), whose totals equal the Statement of Net Position (p1). Detail: budgetary comparison schedules for every fund (General pp7-11 by department and object, major special revenue funds pp12-16, each nonmajor fund pp19-28); the nonmajor combining schedule (pp17-18) is not recorded to avoid double counting (its function grouping was used for the Emergency 911 Fund spending: public welfare). Lines with zero actual (budget only) are omitted. Debt service fund schedules print one 'Debt Service' line (statement p6 splits it into principal 245,000 and interest 92,925). The tax schedule (p29) covers all subdivisions and is not recorded. Read pages 1-29 of 29
